body-classes: qc-manual

Quality control (QC) is the visual review of HALFpipe outputs. First use [3. Run and check outputs](check_run.qmd) to confirm that processing finished and the expected files are present. Then use this guide to judge whether those outputs are usable.

[Start the QC review](qc/before-starting.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Cheat Sheet](qc/cheat-sheet.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

## Workflow

::: {.qc-workflow-grid}

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.2 Prepare the reports folder](qc/before-starting.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Find the files you need and copy the full folder if you will review it on another computer.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.3 Open the summary report](qc/summary-report.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Check which outputs are ready to review.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.4 Open the QC report](qc/reports.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Open the browser report and rate the available images using the examples in section 4.5.
:::

::: {.qc-nav-card}
[4.6 Rerun if needed and export ratings](qc/rerun.qmd){.qc-card-title}

Review any updated outputs, then save your ratings.
:::

:::

## QC categories

Use the examples to see what to look for in each report type. The ICA-based examples apply when your run produced an ICA-AROMA report.
